objective: Test whether restricting positive supervision to official category 2d pulmonary nodules/masses improves nodule segmentation while treating every other finding and background as negative.

initialization.load_policy: load network weights only with --init-checkpoint; reset optimizer, AMP scaler, scheduler, update counter, and RNG-controlled run state

data_design.negative_case_policy: sample all cases with no category-2d finding; their other findings and background contribute only zero-target nodule supervision
data_design.schedule_policy: 75% category-2d positive events and 25% nodule-negative-case events, exactly per 400 global events (one DDP optimizer epoch)
data_design.positive_event_prompt_policy: one category-2d target prompt is positive; two non-2d prompts are zero-target negatives
data_design.negative_event_prompt_policy: one category-2d query plus two non-2d prompts are all zero-target negatives

preprocessing.normalization: crop native CT to nonzero, clip HU to [-1024, 1024], divide by 1024, then trilinear resample

schedule.positive_crop_policy: materialized patch starts contain the selected category-2d target positive point
schedule.target_sampling: cycling shuffled finding-uniform pool over 1743 category-2d training findings

training.augmentation: none added beyond VoxTell patch sampling

validation.evaluation_policy: training pauses after each milestone; evaluate the complete fixed 200-case/381-finding validation set using all four GPUs
validation.primary_nodule_metric: mean global Dice over the 132 val200 category-2d findings
validation.primary_nodule_hit: global Dice >= 0.1 over the same 132 findings
validation.reporting: each milestone report includes overall, every official category, and category-2d nodule Dice/hit; the source Exp017 epoch-100 nodule result is the initial reference
